steps.message: Quais são as 5 lojas com mais chamados abertos em agosto de 2026 na praça Natal?

oracle.sql: SELECT store_name, COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) GROUP BY store_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
